sample: Same 32 previously seen exploratory events; dev10 and disjoint confirmation22. Confirmation22 is not independent holdout and was used in earlier experiments.

native_original_config.sample: same 32 prior development events; original published protocol reproduction, not new held-out efficacy

native_baseline_provenance: Original wrapper used natively, source and input images hashed; no retrospective vision-forward trace claimed for those 32 native baseline calls.

protocol_disclosure.expected_count: Original GT-derived physical referent count retained in baseline and every visual intervention; no target identities or GT points in image processing.
protocol_disclosure.images: Best scoring branch keeps original paired full image plus gaze-derived source-resolution detail. Single main-image branch remains a separately scored ablation and failed on dev10.
protocol_disclosure.referents: Original physical-referent output for baseline comparison; previously accepted per-mention protocol remains archived separately and is not being counted as these gains.
protocol_disclosure.evaluation: Original Experiment 2 evaluator, frozen original panels and source-normalized coordinates. No change to GT or matching.

causal_limits: Multiple candidates screened on dev10; exploratory selection.
Mirror and scale controls separate attention-location effects from changing detail magnification.
Improved old-subset numbers do not establish improvement on the full 4000-event baseline.
No claim heatmap/foveation is effective solely because a combined score improves. Compare components.

treatment_coverage.method: Per-condition scores restricted to the 23 interactions where paired image hashes or prompt differ from native original wrapper. The remaining 9 reproduce identical response with identical images and prompt.
treatment_coverage.warning: These 23 interactions are selected by input-change status, not GT outcome. All 32 event intention-to-treat scores are also retained separately.

interpretation: All-32 results are intention-to-treat and include nine exact RGB fallback events. Treatment-on estimate is separately reported for the 23 events whose image hashes or prompt geometry differed from the native wrapper. Selection of development and confirmation events predates this run; neither set is a prospective holdout.
